title: Last Nights Dream
content: Lately I’ve not been remembering my dreams but last night I had two that bled into each other. In the first one I don’t remember much of the detail except I was watching kids and the dream was scary. There was an old hag in the house, we were running around an old dark house trying to escape and I woke up at a dead end with her closing in. I woke up and smoked a cigarette and went back to sleep. (Much like the dream hag I saw on here a few posts ago now that I think about it). I didn’t know the kids IRL, not real people. Okay second dream right after I go lay back down and for some reason I’m with a man who is not my partner, we’re in my car and he’s looking for something. Like I’m driving him around while he’s pointing and directing me. We stop someplace and I’m inside chatting with someone, he comes up and asks for my keys to get something out of the car. I give him the keys and then a couple minutes later he’s not back so I go out front and my car is at the end of the street in a horrible accident and ALL 5 Of my irl dogs are running around like they were in the back of the car or something. Which I would never do and I would especially not leave them in the car if I had to drive with them. But there they were. So then I have to call my partner to pick me up, explain my car got stolen. He does not freak out and he’s not abusive so I must be dreaming 🙄 anyway He takes me home and I’m on the porch smoking a cigarette and all of a sudden these kids I was watching in the LAST dream are there. I look up, their dad is in the car waiting for them and he waves to me. One of the kids presses something in my hands and runs off, I look down and it’s a straw and a paper towel full of something bright orange like he wanted me to snort it! He says “you forgot this” before he runs off. Like…. WHAT. And nobody mentions the freaking literal demon hag that tried to kill us earlier. They just smile and run off back to their car and I woke up. They were like 8! It was SO weird, all of it. And what did they want me to snort So yeah. Just thought I’d share even though there’s no mall. Does not have to be a mall. Lol
